description: This file defines a REST controller for user-related operations in a Spring Boot application, handling endpoints for reading user information.

classes.name: UserController
classes.description: A REST controller that manages user-related endpoints, allowing retrieval of user data based on identification or pagination.

methods.name: readUser
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch a single user identified by the 'identification' path variable.

methods.name: readUsers
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch a paginated list of users.
